story.title: Redact PII from text
story.goal: Replace emails and phone numbers in text with [EMAIL] and [PHONE].
story.catch: Phone numbers come in two formats — 415-555-2671 and (415) 555-2671 — and a first attempt handles only one of them.
story.steering: Handle both phone formats up front.
story.why_it_matters: A redactor that misses a format does not fail loudly — it quietly ships real phone numbers into a log or an export, and the tests that only cover the format you thought of still pass.
